text:
Microsoft outage affecting MCA email services
Search and rescue operations not impacted by issues with Microsoft services.
We are currently experiencing problems sending and receiving emails due to the worldwide Microsoft outage.
Our search and rescue services are currently unaffected.
In an emergency at the coast call 999 and ask for the Coastguard.
